opening.argument: The video uses warnings about MMM Global to steer viewers toward FutureNet and Future Ad Pro as a supposedly safer long-term Bitcoin opportunity. Rather than stopping at criticism of the earlier scheme, the speaker tells viewers they can “join the opportunity like future net future ad pro” and directs them to “click the link below below, and it will explain.” The presentation is recruitment-oriented: the displayed “FRIENDS TREE BACKOFFICE” contains tier buttons alongside the Future Ad Pro name, while the speaker claims, “All of the top marketers are on this opportunity.” Viewers are also instructed, “You're going to buy $50 ads via Bitcoin,” encouraging participation in a paid system despite the comparison to a prior opportunity alleged to have taken participants’ money.
